WITH fund_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN sp.boxx IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxx != 0 AND sp.boxy IS NOT NULL 
      THEN (sp.boxy - sp.boxx) / sp.boxx 
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN sp.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND sp.volm3 != 0 AND sp.aream2 IS NOT NULL 
      THEN sp.aream2 / sp.volm3 
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS area_vol_ratio
  FROM scanspatial sp
  JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(area_vol_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM fund_metrics
  WHERE area_vol_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  fm.fundflux,
  fm.avg_y_vs_x_diff,
  fm.area_vol_ratio,
  fm.area_vol_ratio - oa.avg_ratio AS above_average
FROM fund_metrics fm
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE fm.area_vol_ratio > oa.avg_ratio
  AND fm.area_vol_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY fm.area_vol_ratio DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Records where boxx = 0 or volm3 = 0 are excluded from calculations to prevent division by zero, as the request does not explicitly specify handling for these edge cases.
Area-to-volume ratio per funding source is calculated as the average of individual (aream2 / volm3) quotients, rather than an aggregate ratio (sum of aream2) / (sum of volm3).

alternatives.interpretation: The area-to-volume ratio per funding source is computed as the aggregate ratio (total area ÷ total volume) rather than the average of individual record ratios.

WITH fund_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN sp.boxx IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxx != 0 AND sp.boxy IS NOT NULL 
      THEN (sp.boxy - sp.boxx) / sp.boxx 
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sp.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND sp.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN sp.aream2 ELSE NULL END) / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN sp.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND sp.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN sp.volm3 ELSE NULL END), 0) AS area_vol_ratio
  FROM scanspatial sp
  JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),

  SELECT AVG(area_vol_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM fund_metrics
  WHERE area_vol_ratio IS NOT NULL
)

  fm.area_vol_ratio,

FROM fund_metrics fm
